exposure: medical indications for termination of pregnancy (fetal, obstetric, maternal)
methods used for induction of labor
outcome: prevalence of different medical indications for termination
requirement for additional methods of labor induction
cohort: This study included 954 pregnancy terminations after 10 weeks of gestation for medical indications performed between 2010 and 2024 at a tertiary referral center.
finding: Major fetal anomalies, particularly central nervous system anomalies, are the most common reason for pursuing termination of pregnancy, with a significant number of terminations occurring at or after 24 weeks gestation, especially in obstetric and maternal indication groups.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery was vaginal in 96.43% of the patients.
gest_age: Terminations occurred after 10 weeks of gestation, with a median gestational age of 14 weeks in the maternal indication group, and 15.62% of terminations were at or above 24 weeks of gestation.
